topics.label: Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning objectives on cancer causation, and establishes the core themes to be discussed.

topics.label: Cancer Etiology, Intrinsic Risk, and Epidemiology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the conceptual foundations of cancer etiology by examining how intrinsic biological errors and environmental exposures interact across global populations.

topics.label: Pathogens and Infectious Drivers of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how biological pathogens drive oncogenesis through mechanisms illustrated by Burkitt lymphoma.

topics.label: Chemical and Physical Mutagens and Metabolic Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how chemical and physical agents undergo metabolic processing to cause DNA damage and mutations.

topics.label: Tumour Promotion, Inflammation, and Host Context
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how non-mutagenic promotional processes, tissue inflammation, and host developmental timing facilitate malignant growth.

topics.label: Methodologies for Identifying Carcinogens and Assessing Risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the scientific methodologies used to identify carcinogens and evaluate cancer risk.
